leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement semantic HTML elements within Angular components to improve screen reader navigation
Apply ARIA attributes to Angular templates for enhanced assistive technology support
Configure keyboard navigation handlers for interactive Angular components
Bind accessible form controls with proper labels and validation announcements
Initialize focus management strategies for dynamic content updates in Angular applications
Render accessible color contrast and text scaling in Angular component styles
Integrate screen reader testing tools into the Angular development workflow
